d7Security.intro: How you sign in, and where you're signed in now.
d7Security.account.title: Email and password
d7Security.email.label: Email
d7Security.email.hint: {email}. Sign-in links and account notices go here.
d7Security.email.dialogBody: We send a confirmation to your current address first, then a link to the new one. Your email changes once both links are opened.
d7Security.email.same: That is already your email address.
d7Security.password.label: Password
d7Security.password.hint: Choose a new one at any time. You can sign out every other device at the same time.
d7Security.twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
d7Security.twoFactor.intro: Two-step sign-in (2FA) adds a code from an authenticator app, so a stolen password isn't enough to get into your account.
d7Security.twoFactor.offHint: Sign in with your password and a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone.
d7Security.twoFactor.onHint: You sign in with your password and a code from your authenticator app. Backup codes get you in if you lose your phone.
d7Security.twoFactor.regenerateBody: Your old backup codes stop working. Enter your password to continue.
d7Security.twoFactor.turnOffBody: Your account will be protected by your password alone. Enter your password to turn it off.
d7Security.setup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
d7Security.setup.scanBody: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then continue.
d7Security.setup.qrLabel: QR code to add your account to an authenticator app
d7Security.setup.manualLabel: Or enter this key by hand
d7Security.setup.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Reveal the key and type it in instead.
d7Security.setup.codeBody: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows now.
d7Security.setup.codesBody: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. We won't show them again.
d7Security.setup.fileHint: Each code works once. Keep this file somewhere only you can reach.
d7Security.codes.title: Your new backup codes
d7Security.passkeys.title: Passkeys
d7Security.passkeys.intro: A passkey lets you sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN, with no password to type or leak.
d7Security.passkeys.unsupported: This browser can't create passkeys. Try another browser or device.
d7Security.passkeys.removeBody: You can't sign in with “{name}” any more. Your password still works.
d7Security.sessions.title: Sessions
d7Security.sessions.intro: Where you're signed in. If you don't recognise a device, sign it out and change your password.
d7Security.sessions.signOutOthersBody: Every other device signs out. This one stays signed in.
d7Security.sessions.privacy: We show the browser and system only. We don't show or keep the network address of a session.
d7Security.sessions.signedOutOthers: Every other device is signed out.
d7Security.emailLink.title: Sign-in by email link
d7Security.emailLink.body: A sign-in link sent to your email works once and expires after 10 minutes. Anyone who can read your email can use it, so keep your email account safe too.
d7Security.error.code: That code isn't right. Check your app and try again.
d7Security.error.backupCode: That backup code isn't right, or it was already used.
d7Security.error.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
d7Security.error.notFresh: For your safety, sign in again to do this.
d7Security.error.expiredStep: This sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.
d7Security.signin.codeBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows.
d7Security.signin.passkeyFailed: That didn't work. Try again, or sign in with your password.
